transcript.en: Hello and welcome to today's 'Buyer Beware' programme, where we give you some tips on how to spend your money wisely.
transcript.zh: 你好，欢迎来到今天的《购物要当心》节目。我们将向你介绍几点如何明智花钱的技巧。

transcript.en: Now, in today's show we're looking at beds for children and babies.
transcript.zh: 我们将在今天的节目介绍婴儿床

transcript.en: Let's start by looking at baby cots, that's for children of up to three years old.
transcript.zh: 让我们从3岁小孩的婴儿床开始。

transcript.en: We tested three different cots all in the budget price range and, as usual, we will feature the good points, the problems and our verdict.
transcript.zh: 我们在预算价格内测试了3种不同的小床。像平时一样，我们将重点介绍它们的优点、问题和我们的结论。

transcript.en: The first cot we looked at was by Baby Safe and it had several good points to recommend it.
transcript.zh: 我们看的第一张小床出自“婴儿安全”，它有几点好处值得推荐。

transcript.en: Our testers liked the fact that it had four wheels, so it was easy to move around.
transcript.zh: 我们的测试者喜欢它有四个轱辘，所以很好移动。

transcript.en: The only slight problems with this cot were that it had no brakes, but they didn't think that mattered too much.
transcript.zh: 唯一的小缺憾是这张小床没有刹车，但是他们认为这不太重要。

transcript.en: At first they were a bit concerned about the side bar, because they felt babies could trap their fingers in it, but our testers felt that this was unlikely to happen so they have given this one a verdict of 'satisfactory'.
transcript.zh: 开始他们有点担心侧栏，因为他们感觉婴儿的手指可能会卡在里面，但是我们的测试者认为这是不可能的，所以他们对这张床的评价是“满意”。

transcript.en: The next cot was by Choice Cots and this time our testers were pleased to find a cot which is simple to put together - unlike others we looked at.
transcript.zh: 第二张小床来自“精选床”，这次我们的测试者很高兴的发现这个床不像其他床一样，这个很容易组装。

transcript.en: On the minus side, our testers did not like the fact that the side of the cot did not drop down, making it difficult to pick up newborn babies.
transcript.zh: 从坏的方面讲，我们的测试者不喜欢小床的两侧不能降下来，这很难抱起新生儿。

transcript.en: However, the real problem with this cot was the space between the bars; our testers found they were too wide and a baby could easily trap his head.
transcript.zh: 然而，真正的问题是小床侧栏间的距离。我们的测试者发现它们太宽了，婴儿的头很容易卡在里面。

transcript.en: We felt this was a real safety hazard and so we have labelled this one dangerous, I'm afraid.
transcript.zh: 我们觉得这是一个安全隐患，恐怕我们对它的结论是“危险”。

transcript.en: And finally better news for the Mother's Choice cot.
transcript.zh: 最后，好消息是来自“母亲的选择”的小床。

transcript.en: This cot was slightly different in that, although the side bar did not drop down, the base could be raised or lowered into two different positions making it safe as well as convenient.
transcript.zh: 这张小床有点不同，尽管侧栏不能下降，但是它的底座可以朝两个不同的方向升高或降低，使小床安全又方便。

transcript.en: The negatives for this one were quite minor; the only niggle everyone had was the fact that it has no wheels and the only other problem anyone could find, was that there were pictures which were simply stuck on and so could easily become detached.
transcript.zh: 它的缺点微不足道，每个人都能挑出的问题是它没有轮子。另一点是产品上面的图片只是简单的黏贴，容易脱落。

transcript.en: The makers have now promised to discontinue this practice.
transcript.zh: 制造商已经承诺终止这种做法

transcript.en: As this cot will then be safe in every way, we have made the Mother's Choice cot our best buy.
transcript.zh: 这张小床从各方面来看都是安全的，我们认为“母亲的选择”是最佳产品。

transcript.en: Congratulations Mother's Choice!
transcript.zh: 恭喜“母亲的选择”

transcript.en: So, what features should you look for in a baby's cot?
transcript.zh: 那么，你应该挑选什么样的婴儿床呢？

transcript.en: Well obviously safety is a very important factor as well as comfort and convenience.
transcript.zh: 显然，安全、舒适和便捷是最重要的因素。

transcript.en: We recommend that, if you are buying a cot, do make sure that any metal present is not rusted or bent in any way.
transcript.zh: 如果你要买一张小床，我们建议你确保任何金属不能生锈或弯曲。

transcript.en: You should ensure your cot has only rounded or smooth edging without any sharp edges, this is especially important for wooden cots.
transcript.zh: 你还要确定小床的边缘是圆的或平滑的，没有任何锋利的边缘，这对于木床来说尤为重要。

transcript.en: And now on to beds for toddlers...
transcript.zh: 现在，对于初学走路的婴儿床……
